resources.string: Talk button, and copies to your Mac

Lets OpenScribe work with your Mac from any app: hold a phone button you choose (such as volume down) to dictate, and send what you copy to your Mac\'s clipboard. OpenScribe watches only that button and the moment you copy, such as a tap on a Copy button. It does not read your screen or what you type, and copies marked sensitive, like passwords, are never sent.
